verdict.rationale: AnythingLLM documents built-in TTS/STT support (comm-3) and automatic meeting transcription/summarization (docs-3, docs-10), showing some voice-to-text and text-to-voice capability, but there's no evidence of voice notes being transcribed in chat or of live, real-time voice conversations with the assistant. Missing for 10: documented voice-note upload/transcription in chat, live/streaming voice conversation mode, and independent hands-on confirmation of these voice features working.
